Nice to meet you.
My name is Uoganto, and I’m an independent VTuber.
After seeing your many wonderful works, I’d love for you to draw my character, so I’m reaching out with this request.

〇Character Profile
A 17-year-old girl who loves video games and calls herself a genius.
She has a rabbit in her pupils, her eyebrows tend to form a slight "8" shape, and her eyes are slightly droopy.
Reference: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1-kvOaTUBk00I2Hb7wl5KS8JwxbN2WFf-/view?usp=drive_link

〇 requested outfit
Cooking girl
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lX84HxrpyDQJqkq7o0eunJA8-o6VWh7o/view?usp=drive_link

〇Request Details
・I’ll leave the background, situation, pose, and composition up to you.
・It would be greatly appreciated if the head is not cut off in the frame.
・If possible, I would appreciate it if you could create different facial expressions.

〇Delivery Format
 Please deliver in PSD format, with layers separated at least into "character" and "other elements." (The level of detail is up to you.)

〇Intended Use
In addition to personal viewing, I would like to request permission to use the artwork for social media and streaming activities (e.g., thumbnails, image distribution, etc.).
I would also like to use it for VTuber activities within the scope where no direct monetary exchange is involved (excluding merchandise creation).

I would greatly appreciate it if you could consider this request.
